messages:
jasper: Quick heads-up — Amy's presenting remotely. Audio check failed on recorder during rehearsal. Can stream team confirm backup and mic levels?

devon (stream): Saw a recorder error: 'write timeout' then auto-retry. I'm switching to local SSD spool and restarting obs-capture.

nina (ops): Sending Amy backup dial-in and asking to mute except when answering. Also enabling echo-cancellation on stage mics.

cam-bot: Encoder-01 status=OK, obs-capture=RESTARTING, captions-latency=2.1s

devon (stream): Restart done. Captions tuned to 1.5s by lowering batch window. Local spool active.

jasper: Can someone bump Amy's gain by +2dB when she starts? She said her audio is a bit soft.

devon (stream): Roger. I'll apply +2dB on fader when she goes live. Monitoring for 10m post-event for uploads.

amy (ceo): Thanks — I'll keep answers short. If slides lag, tell me and I'll move slower.

nina (ops): Amy confirmed backup link and mute. All set.

jasper: Perfect. I'll post a 30s pre-start cue in the stage channel and then hand off to you, Devon.

devon (stream): Ready on my side. Recording resumed to SSD. Watching encoder and captions.

jasper: Go-live in 10s. Good luck team!
